QUALITY · CERTIFICATIONS

Quality is not a department —
it is our culture.

Quality influences every decision we make, every process we design, and every product that leaves our facility. At OSRM Tech Pack, quality is our identity and our strongest commitment to customers.

OUR APPROACH

Excellence is not an act — it is a habit.

Powered by deep industry knowledge, disciplined systems, and modern infrastructure, OSRM delivers premium, reliable, and robust packaging solutions. Our mission is simple: to manufacture packaging that enhances our customers' efficiency, protects their product, and performs flawlessly every time.

Our quality framework is built on four pillars — hygiene & safety, controlled manufacturing, three-layer inspection, and a culture of continuous improvement — verified by triple ISO certification and validated by 180+ clients across 15+ countries.

QUALITY FRAMEWORK

Four pillars that hold every bag we ship.

PILLAR 01

World-class hygiene & safety standards

Strict hygiene and safety practices across all three manufacturing units. Employee hygiene, plant-level sanitation, and controlled environments ensure every product meets global standards. Our integrated ERP system provides complete traceability, process consistency, and real-time monitoring on every batch.

PILLAR 02

100% controlled manufacturing

Our plants house next-generation global machinery, making OSRM one of the leading packaging manufacturers in India. From extrusion, weaving, and lamination to printing and conversion — every operation is monitored and validated by trained quality professionals at every stage.

PILLAR 03

3-Layer quality control system

Our three-step inspection framework runs from raw material selection to final dispatch:

  • Centralised Quality Check Department with dedicated QC teams in every production area
  • Finished-goods quality check as per ISO 9001:2015 standards
  • Third-party external inspection for independent quality validation

Result: reduced breakage and wastage at the cement plant, and more efficient filling-line operations for our customers.

PILLAR 04

What drives us

Disciplined systems. Modern infrastructure. Deep industry knowledge. Owner-led supervision on every account. These are the things that turn quality from a checklist into a culture — one that has earned OSRM its place with the world's most demanding cement producers.

WHAT WE TEST

Every bag, measured against real-world conditions.

TEST 01

Tensile strength & tape tenacity

Multi-point tensile testing on tape and fabric to ensure the bag will hold its rated weight without splitting or stretching under load. Critical for cement bags handling 25–50 kg.

TEST 02

GSM & thickness consistency

Continuous monitoring of fabric weight per square metre and lamination thickness — measured by Starlinger's BST online thickness measurement system during production.

TEST 03

Print fidelity & colour accuracy

Pantone colour matching, registration tolerance, and brand-logo sharpness verified against approved customer artwork. Viscosity controllers maintain print quality across long runs.

TEST 04

Air permeability & dust emission

Microstar+ bilateral micro-perforation tested for optimal air evacuation during filling — reducing dust emission at the cement plant and improving filling-line throughput.

TEST 05

Drop test & transport simulation

Filled bags subjected to drop tests from cement-plant stack heights and simulated transport vibration to verify seam integrity, valve durability, and stacking stability.

TEST 06

UV resistance & weatherability

Accelerated UV exposure testing to confirm bags retain integrity through outdoor storage and long-distance transport — critical for export shipments to Africa, Middle East, and SE Asia.
